records.title: Research on Intra-Chip Fusion Deployment and Optimization of Embodied Intelligence Business Operator NPU
records.reason: 一次arXiv本文はPhytium/Cambricon MLU370上でViT推論のhead sparsification、embedding圧縮、INT8/mixed precision、operator fusionとsingle-card pipelineを評価し、全処理latency 18.7ms・Jetson AGX Xavier比2.89xを報告する。一方、対象modelはViTとrobotics operatorでLLM実験はなく、NeuPIMs系統へのhardware接続は間接的。

records.title: Retrieval-Augmented Detection of Potentially Abusive Clauses in Chilean Terms of Service
records.reason: チリ消費者契約条項のabusive clause detectionをRAGで支援する法務応用で、inference efficiency方式ではない。

records.title: Squeezing Capacity from Multimodal Large Language Models for Subject-driven Generation
records.reason: subject-driven image generationでmultimodal capacityを高める研究で、token/computation削減の方式ではない。

records.title: Theoretical Analysis of Sparse Optimization with Reparameterization, Weight Decay, and Adaptive Learning Rate
records.reason: sparse optimizationのreparameterization/weight decay/learning-rate理論が対象で、LLM推論ではなく最適化・学習理論。

records.title: AME-TS: Anchored Mixture-of-Experts for Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: 一次本文は時系列foundation modelのstructure-guided sparse MoE routingを扱い、regime priorでexpert selectionを促す。MoE/conditional compute系譜との接点はあるが、時系列予測向けでLLMの推論FLOPs/latency削減の直接評価はなく、LLM serving転用は未確認。
